models.title: Effective annual cost of forgoing a trade discount
models.summary: The example compounds the forgone discount over the extra credit period to an effective annual cost.

relationship.original_equation: Effective annual cost = (1 + discount/(1-discount))^(year length/extra credit period) - 1
relationship.translation_notes: Year and delay are physical durations in days and their ratio is dimensionless. The selected year length is an input; the rate is a base-one fraction. This is a trade-credit cash-discount application, distinct from nominal-to-effective rate conversion.
